files.label: Files
files.why: Everything that is tracked in git and is not a binary: code, tests, docs and configuration.

code_lines.label: Lines of code
code_lines.why: Without comments and blank lines. Tests are a large share of it, so read this next to the directory table.

functions.label: Functions and methods
functions.why: How many named pieces of behaviour there are to understand. Most have no description yet.

docstrings.label: Python functions with a docstring
docstrings.why: What can be explained from the code alone. The rest needs a written note; JavaScript is not counted.

routes.label: API routes
routes.why: Everything the outside world can ask the backend to do.

commits.label: Commits
commits.why: How much the code has moved. The sparkline is per month.

tests_written.label: Tests written
tests_written.why: Functions named test_* in test files. A count of tests, not of how much of the code they cover.

nodes.label: Graph nodes
nodes.why: Files, functions and concepts in the Graphify graph, the map used to find what is connected to what.

links.label: Graph links
links.why: Relations between those nodes. Dense areas are where a change is most likely to reach other code.
